settings.heading: What a home sauna actually costs
settings.intro_fact: $1,800 gets it inside and assembled, $600 gets it inside, and the curb is free — then the electrician is a separate bill we do not estimate. 47 of our 139 priced saunas publish a rated power; for the other 92 nobody can compute a running cost, so this page does not pretend to.
settings.collection_label: See every sauna these figures come from
settings.dataset_name: InHouse Wellness home sauna cost tables
settings.dataset_description: Purchase price, delivery tier, rated power and state electricity rate for 139 priced home saunas, each figure carrying its source and fetch date. Rated power is present for 47; the remaining 92 are recorded as absent rather than estimated.
